moon.conjunction: What you want and what you need are the same thing, which makes you singular and rather one-note; you were born near a new moon.
moon.harmonious: Your intentions and your instincts agree, so you rarely argue with yourself and can seem unfairly untroubled to people who do.
moon.square: What you want keeps colliding with what you need, and you tend to secure one at the cost of the other before noticing.
moon.opposition: You were born near a full moon and you feel it: pulled between doing and resting, and often meeting the argument in somebody else.

mercury.conjunction: You think of yourself as your mind, so your opinions and your identity are hard to prise apart and disagreement lands personally.
mercury.harmonious: You can say what you mean without effort, and explaining yourself is one of the ways you work out who you are.
mercury.square: Your thinking undercuts your confidence, or your confidence overrides your thinking, and either way the second-guessing arrives after you have committed.
mercury.opposition: You argue with your own reasoning as though it belonged to someone else, and it takes another person to make you finish the thought.

venus.conjunction: Being liked and being yourself are the same project, and charm comes so easily that you have used it before noticing.
venus.harmonious: You are comfortable inside your own taste, and warmth is something people register about you within the first few minutes.
venus.square: What you want and what would please everyone pull apart, and you spend energy on being agreeable that you needed elsewhere.
venus.opposition: You find out what you are worth by watching how somebody else responds to you, which works until they stop.

mars.conjunction: You are your own engine: forceful, competitive, quick to heat, and thoroughly miserable when there is nothing to push against.
mars.harmonious: Your energy is available when you want it, you act on decisions rather than sitting with them, and courage is not something you have to summon.
mars.square: You go at things too hard and then wonder why you are exhausted; the temper and the ambition are the same piece of wiring.
mars.opposition: Your drive keeps arriving from outside, through rivals and provocation, and you do your best work when somebody has annoyed you.

jupiter.conjunction: You expect things to work out and often enough they do, but you take on more than one person can reasonably carry.
jupiter.harmonious: Confidence and generosity come easily, opportunities find you, and you have seldom had to fight for the benefit of the doubt.
jupiter.square: Your reach exceeds your grasp on a regular basis, and the overestimate is always of yourself rather than of the situation.
jupiter.opposition: People keep offering you more than you can handle, and you locate your limits only by going some way past them.

saturn.conjunction: You were serious early, you hold yourself to a standard nobody set, and your own approval is the hardest of all to obtain.
saturn.harmonious: You are steady in a way that does not need announcing, you finish what you start, and responsibility sits on you comfortably.
saturn.square: Something in you cancels your own permission, and you work twice as hard for the confidence other people appear to have been issued at birth.
saturn.opposition: Authority turns up as somebody else — a parent, a boss, a critic — and the work of your life is not needing their sign-off.

uranus.conjunction: You are constitutionally unable to do it the ordinary way, and your sense of who you are depends on being unpredictable.
uranus.harmonious: Your originality is usable rather than disruptive: you find the odd solution, and people accept it because you are not defensive about it.
uranus.square: You break your own arrangements just as they settle, and the freedom you keep insisting on costs you more than you will admit.
uranus.opposition: The disruption comes from outside, through people who will not be managed, and your life changes direction without much warning.

neptune.conjunction: Your sense of who you are is porous, you take on the colour of whatever surrounds you, and you are more artistic than certain.
neptune.harmonious: Imagination and compassion are simply part of your character, and you can lose yourself in making something without losing your footing.
neptune.square: You do not quite know who you are, and you fill the gap with an ideal, an image, or something that blurs the question.
neptune.opposition: People project onto you and you let them, so you have been idealised and then disappointed in roughly equal measure.

pluto.conjunction: There is a force in you that others feel before they can name it, and you have already been remade at least once.
pluto.harmonious: You can go the whole way into something and come back out again, which makes you useful in the situations everyone else avoids.
pluto.square: You fight for control, including over yourself, and the tighter you grip the more thoroughly the situation makes you rebuild.
pluto.opposition: Power arrives through other people, and you have had to learn the difference between influencing somebody and overpowering them.

ascendant.conjunction: The person people meet is the person you are; there is very little front, for better and for worse.
ascendant.harmonious: How you come across and who you actually are agree with each other, so you make a coherent impression without working at it.
ascendant.square: The impression you make gets in your own way, and people keep responding to a version of you that you did not intend.
ascendant.opposition: You only see yourself clearly in company, and the way others describe you rarely matches how you experience yourself.

midheaven.conjunction: What you do and who you are cannot be separated, which makes work meaningful and makes losing it a crisis of identity.
midheaven.harmonious: Your character and your direction point the same way, so getting on is a matter of being more yourself rather than less.
midheaven.square: Your ambition and your nature are at odds, and you have held jobs that suited your talent but not your temperament.
midheaven.opposition: Your public direction pulls against your private foundation, and you cannot advance in one without paying for it in the other.
